hoaxes.title: Nanbeige's new open coding model writes every commit message as a haiku
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Nanbeige4.3-33B is an open coding model on Hugging Face with a 524,288-token context window.

hoaxes.title: A24 will let Elden Ring movie ticket buyers choose an easy or hard difficulty cut
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The WSJ reports A24's Elden Ring film costs nearly $200 million; it opens on March 3, 2028.

hoaxes.title: Final Fantasy Resonance adds a mode that turns every battle into a rhythm game
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Final Fantasy Resonance is an HD-2D spinoff that peaked at 27,933 Steam players on day one.

hoaxes.title: Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro will ship with a stylus that doubles as a USB-C drive
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple holds its Pro and Tell event on Oct 28, where a touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro is expected.
